A Nopon asked about
our stock of poisons.

rows.label: tlk401005_msg0003
rows.name:
I said we don't carry any. The Nopon
backed down without a fuss, but...

rows.label: tlk401005_msg0004
rows.name:
It seems the same Nopon has been
asking around other places too.

rows.label: tlk401005_msg0005
rows.name: What could that Nopon be planning...
